messages:
sam (sales): BetaCorp hitting JSON parse errors during their POC when using function calls + json_mode. Need quick triage before EOW.
beta-corp-jules (customer): raw output often looks valid then has a short suffix: `{\"items\": [{\"id\":\"x1\",\"ok\":true}]}`\nPS: last row had an issue`
lee (solutions): likely streaming + rate-limit truncation. can you share a request id and whether you used streaming?
beta-corp-jules (customer): req=bcp_202, sdk=1.5, stream=true. logs show a couple 429s around the time.
rate-alert-bot: Alert: org beta-corp qps spike 2025-03-14T09:23:04Z qps=39 limit=35
arya (eng-runtime): immediate fixes: 1) set header `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` 2) enable `truncate_trailing_text=true` on the route 3) increase token budget or use atomic_response to buffer until complete. also server-side validator to reject responses that don't end with `}`.
lee (solutions): parallel: offer a short-term QPS uplift for the POC window. sales-ops can quote a two-week boost.
pat (security): BetaCorp requires 12mo retention and no plaintext request bodies. Dedicated route supports body redaction and custom retention in contract; hosted default is 30d.
sam (sales): I'll get sales-ops/legal looped and send a short runbook with headers + a small retry snippet. Jules, please send one failing raw sample and well escalate if 429s persist.
beta-corp-jules (customer): switched to strict + truncate locally: parse success up to ~96%. sending new sample bcp_203 now. thanks.
